Migration.title: Data migration
Migration.body:
Taking over from an existing system runs here as a plan with steps: discovery, mapping, a trial run, going live and verification.

Every step shows its state and who acts next: you, an agent or the system. A step that moves money waits for your approval instead of running silently.

If the takeover diverges, there are real ways back: reverse or restore.
